MEASURED (fleet c6e91a8, 12 h to 10-07 17:30Z, 80 bots, 441 bot-h): 68 stone + 55 wooden swords in 73 of 80 bags (123 slots, ~4.9% of used slots), 1 sword crafted in 12 h, 3 sword craft proposals in 70,115 decisions in 24 h, 0 sword pickups by the sweep; 24 h sword ledger: 1 banked spare, 1 snapshot blip, 0 lost. Kit-plant stock ~165 slots (wildflowers 34, melon_slice 27, brown_mushroom 26, kelp 19, red_mushroom 12, rose_bush 9, cocoa_beans 9, peony 8 ...). THE CHANGE (bots/src/peacefulkit.mjs + foodskip/bankable/composter/skills/admission/prompt/cognitive): FOOD_SKIP=auto|on|off (default auto = the server's difficulty packet says peaceful; foodskip.mjs attachDifficulty now refreshes the in-process decision from every packet). Swords: admission refuses craft <sword> (peaceful_no_sword, remedy 'craft a pickaxe, axe or shovel, or gather instead'), the craft skill refuses it at depth 0, the prompt stops offering one, the sweep does not walk to a sword drop, and a RUNNING deposit keeps no sword (every usable copy goes; spent copies never; the base keeps the best copy of each name); admission/advice/milestone counts keep the base rule, so a sword never makes a deposit due (no new trip). Compost: the town composter also takes 30 kit plants WHOLE (melon_slice, kelp, brown/red mushroom, cocoa_beans, sweet_berries, torchflower_seeds, pitcher_pod, every small/tall flower incl. wildflowers, pink_petals, cactus_flower, torchflower, pitcher_plant, eyeblossoms, wither_rose); saplings above 16/species and apples above 4 unchanged; dried_kelp, glow_berries, bush, firefly_bush, moss_carpet, dry grass, bread NOT approved; startableJunk stops no-op compost orders on full bags while the switch is on (fillDecision at the composter's level) -- A SECOND EFFECT IN THIS VARIABLE: it also applies to the food policy's apple-only full bags, so compost-visit counts can differ between arms there too; `_compost` rows carry args.items (complete map) + args.peaceful, also on interrupted visits (status aborted, args.incomplete when an insert was in flight); a deposit whose only eligible copies are the kit's swords never starts the full-chest recovery or closes the bank; one `_peaceful_kit` row per process per change of (decision, difficulty). PAPER (sandbox2, Paper 1.21.8-60, RCON only, hopper -> composter -> hopper, 64 each): all 30 kit plants consumed 64/64, chance estimates consistent with vanilla; negative controls (swords, egg, flint, bamboo, dead_bush, ink_sac) 0. require.name: compost visits (the town composter is used here)
deposits that moved items (the bank is visited here)

draw_exposure.note: 73 of 80 bots hold a sword and 69-70 hold a kit plant, so the draw only needs pools that bank and compost at all.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 1 canary _peaceful_kit active=1 row AND X1 >= 3 canary BOTS whose deposit/town_deposit row took a sword while active AND X2 >= 3 canary BOTS that composted a kit plant while active. The read prints X1's ceiling (canary bots holding a sword at the cut).

own_lines.note: LIVENESS: canary _peaceful_kit active=1 rows. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
K0: a canary kit row with difficulty=peaceful and active=0, or mode != auto (the fleet env sets nothing).
K1 crafted(row, SWORD): a canary craft row whose requested item is a sword, success, gained, while that bot's kit row said active=1. A TRIPWIRE: ~1 sword craft/day fleet-wide, never exposure-gated.
POSITIVE CONTROL K1: crafted(row, TOOL) on control rows (72 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

K2 the sword LEDGER: canary falls not explained by a bank row's run interval, a death (-5..+180 s) or a same-name blip (<= 120 s); breach when the canary's lost rate exceeds the control's (control lost 0 in 24 h), or any _compost row composted a sword.
POSITIVE CONTROL K2: the same Ledger on control PICKAXES -- falls the bank reconciliation explained (18 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.
K3 took_last(SWORD): a bank row that took a sword name to 0 from a canary bot whose kit row was not active=1, or from any control bot (the base keeps one copy).
POSITIVE CONTROL K3: took_last(ANY) on control bank rows (43 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

K4 reserve_breaches: a canary _compost row that composted a sapling species and holds < 16 of it, or apples and holds < 4, at END; breach when the canary rate exceeds the control's (the same predicate).
POSITIVE CONTROL K4: control compost rows on which the reserve check was evaluated (21 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.
K5 OFF MEANS OFF: composted_in(items, KIT) on a canary row whose kit row was not active=1 (or args.peaceful == 0), or on ANY control row.
POSITIVE CONTROL K5: composted_in(items, BASE + saplings + apple) on control rows (28 in a 3 h dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.
K6 ONLY THE LIST: off_list(items, BASE + KIT + saplings + apple) on a canary row (bread, dried_kelp, a sword ...).
POSITIVE CONTROL K6: off_list(items, BASE) on control rows (16 in a 3 h dry run: the base composts saplings and apples outside BASE). BLOCKS KEEP.
